title: Function Schedule & Day/Night Allocation
dilemma: Freezing start/end timings for Haldi, Mehendi, Sangeet, and Wedding before contractor talks.
benchmark: Vandana Mohan (WDC): Mandatory 6+ hour buffer between late-night Sangeet and morning wedding to prevent uninspected structural compromises.
direction: Locked in OS: Haldi Day 1 Morning, Mehendi Day 1 Afternoon Split (VEN-001 hotel AC hall + Zone D lawn), Sangeet Day 1 Night, Wedding Day 2 Morning.

options.text: Locked OS Schedule: Day 1 Haldi/Mehendi/Sangeet, Day 2 Morning Vivaha (Certified)

title: Physical Site Survey & Boundary Clearances
dilemma: Ground compaction, drainage gradient, and heavy equipment access across 50m distance.
benchmark: Devika Narain: Laser subfloor leveling with treated timber pedestals must precede all tent framing to prevent standing water ingress.
direction: Vendor must submit stamped CAD drawing showing 50m canopy link, 6m fire tender ring, and drainage slope.
vendorDeliverable: Stamped CAD layout + Soil compaction report (Due T-21 Days)

title: Sun Path, Weather & Thermodynamic Orientation
dilemma: Preventing severe afternoon solar thermal loading and blinding glare in ceremony zones.
benchmark: Abu Jani Sandeep Khosla: 850 g/m² blockout PVC reduces internal heat load by 6°C–8°C compared to translucent tarpaulins.
direction: Locked in OS: Ridge oriented North-South; gable ends face North/South; afternoon sun shielded behind rear BOH kitchen wall.

options.text: Certified N-S Alignment with 850 g/m² Blockout PVC on South/West Walls

title: Master Venue Spatial Zoning (Zones A–E)
dilemma: Zoning 100x160ft (16,000 sq ft) marquee with 40ft Mandap (30ft family flanks), 24x16ft Sangeet stage, and adjacent 60x40ft VIP dining tent.
benchmark: Taj / Oberoi Convention Standards: Clear spatial zoning between ceremonial altar, dining, and party stage ensures zero acoustic or circulation clash.
direction: Locked in OS: 100x160ft Main Marquee + 60x40ft VIP/Elderly Dining Tent + 100ft Road Arrival Tunnel + Post-Wedding Mandap Reuse.

options.text: 100×160ft Master Zoning (40ft Mandap, 24×16ft Stage, 60×40ft VIP Tent) (Certified)

title: Guest vs. Service Circulation Separation
dilemma: Strict segregation of guest arrivals from catering carts, dirty dish collection, and generator fuel lines.
benchmark: Taj / Oberoi Palace Standards: 100% segregated Back-of-House service ring; guests never witness service waste removal.
direction: Decorator must delineate a continuous 6ft rear service corridor behind Zone C leading to service gate.
vendorDeliverable: BOH Circulation Drawing with zero cross-over through guest foyer (Due T-21 Days)

title: Marquee Structure Architecture & Elevation
dilemma: Ensuring unobstructed guest sightlines and certified 100 km/h wind stability.
benchmark: German Roder / Losberger Standard: Clear-span hangars allow full 360-degree crane and jib video arcs with zero center poles.
direction: Locked in OS: 100ft × 160ft German clear-span extruded aluminum alloy (6061-T6), 32ft ridge apex, zero center poles.

options.text: 100×160 German Clear-Span Structure (16,000 sq ft) with 100ft Covered Road Entry Tunnel

title: Dual-Zone HVAC & DG Power Backbone
dilemma: Preventing generator failure or audio-visual buzz while cooling a 500-guest tent.
benchmark: Sound.com: Audio/Video circuits must be isolated through an online double-conversion UPS to eliminate harmonic generator noise.
direction: Locked in OS: 40T package AC in Zone A, desert coolers in Zone C, dual 125 kVA DGs with online UPS on A/V bus.

options.text: Dual 125 kVA Silent DG (3-Bus SLD) + 40T Dedicated Package AC (Certified)

title: Master Color Palette & Metallic Standard
dilemma: Selecting the unified color harmony across all 4 functions to prevent visual chaos.
benchmark: Devika Narain: Calm 70% neutral base (Ivory, Champagne) with rich narrative accents prevents visual fatigue.
direction: Base: Ivory & Champagne Satin with Brushed Champagne Gold metal. Choose your accent tone:

options.text: Option A (Recommended): Royal Amber & Marigold Gold (Vedic sacred warmth, elevates teak mandap)
Option B: Blush Rose & Dusty Peach (Soft romantic contemporary elegance, flattering for photos)
Option C: Deep Emerald & Midnight Navy (Dramatic royal palace opulence, high-contrast evening impact)

title: Material Palette Discipline & Prohibitions
dilemma: Enforcing quality standards and eliminating cheap vendor shortcuts (flex banners, plastic chairs).
benchmark: Rani Pink: Luxury is defined by what you refuse; printed flex banners and plastic chairs destroy a multi-crore aesthetic.
direction: Sign off on the Prohibited Negative List with ₹50,000 penalty clause in vendor rider.

options.text: Approve Strict Prohibited List with ₹50,000 Vendor Violation Penalty Clause (Recommended)
Flexible Guidelines without financial penalty clause

title: Permanent Luxury Base Infrastructure
dilemma: Avoiding teardown costs and wasted hours between multi-day events.
benchmark: International Event Production: Permanent base infrastructure saves 45%–55% of total decor quotation across 4 events.
direction: Locked in OS: Marquee shell, draped ceiling, chandeliers, and neutral carpet stay 100% constant across all 4 events.

options.text: Build-Once-Transform-Many Core Base Infrastructure (Certified)

title: Cinema Lighting Design (CRI > 95)
dilemma: Preventing sickly green skin tones and 120fps video banding on cinema cameras.
benchmark: Joseph Radhik: Low CRI LED stage lighting causes rolling shutter banding on slow-motion films that cannot be fixed in post.
direction: Locked in OS: 3200K cinema profile for indoor ceremonies; 5600K daylight for mehendi; zero 120fps flicker on Sony FX3.

options.text: CRI > 95 Cinema Keylights with 3200K Tungsten Balance & Flicker-Free Profiles

title: Floral Strategy & Structural Reuse Matrix
dilemma: Balancing lush floral density with budget efficiency and 6-hour morning turnaround speed.
benchmark: Devika Narain Floral Architecture: Permanent green foliage base built Day 1; accent garlands swapped via quick-clips in under 90 mins.
direction: Very High density at Mandap & Entrance; High at Sangeet; Low at Buffets. Choose floral philosophy:

options.text: Option A (Recommended): Vedic Royal Hybrid (Marigold & mogra for day, red rose & tuberoses for wedding)
Option B: Modern English Pastel (White hydrangeas, blush spray roses, baby's breath)
Option C: Architectural Foliage & Brass (Eucalyptus, olive branches, brass urlis, minimal cut florals)
options.badge: 🌺 Curated Hybrid: Marigold Altar + Garden Lounge

title: Ceremonial Seating Typography & Concourse Clearance
dilemma: Balancing ceremonial sightlines during 3-hour Vivaha rituals with an uncluttered 35-ft central concourse for free guest movement.
benchmark: The Wedding Design Company: Right-sizing central seating prevents oceans of empty chairs while opening pedestrian arteries.
direction: Locked in DWG A103: 80-chair ceremonial bay (8 rows of 10) flanking 10-ft aisle + 40 chairs in family sofa wings; opens 35-ft clear central concourse.

options.text: Option A (Recommended): 80-Chair Ceremonial Bay + 40 Flank Chairs & Family Sofas (DWG A103)
Option B: Dense 200-Chair Theater Block (Restricts central pedestrian flow)

title: Sacred Mandap Architecture & Smoke Extraction
dilemma: Preventing choking smoke accumulation while providing comfortable close-family seating on 40ft stage.
benchmark: Oberoi Hotels Indoor Ritual Standard: Active mechanical smoke extraction is strictly mandatory for indoor havan fires.
direction: Locked in OS: 40ft wide stage at 3ft elevation centered in 100ft tent with 30ft family flanks; 2mm zinc heat barrier, smoke extraction; repurposed post-ceremony for outdoor photo shoot.

options.text: 40ft Mandap Stage with 30ft Family Flanks + Smoke Canopy + Post-Wedding Photo Reuse (Certified)

title: Dining Court Architecture: Rectangular Central Island & Dual Buffets
dilemma: Eliminating dinner bottlenecks across 350+ guests while separating quick appetizer grazers from full-plate main course diners.
benchmark: Luxury Wedding Banquet Standard: Freestanding multi-sided central island reduces plate/salad wait times by 60% compared to linear buffets.
direction: Locked in DWG A103: Freestanding 20×8ft Rectangular Central Island (salads, chaats, breads, plate stacks) + 70ft Dual Main-Course Baseline + West Cocktail Grazing Lounge.

options.text: Option A (Recommended): 20×8ft Rectangular Central Island + 70ft Dual Main Baseline + West Cocktail Lounge (DWG A103)
Option B: Traditional Linear Perimeter Buffets (Single queue flow)

title: 4-Event Function Transformation Protocol
dilemma: Executing seamless event transitions across Haldi, Mehendi, Sangeet, and Wedding + Mandap outdoor photo reuse without delays.
benchmark: Cineyug Production Playbook: Pre-staging modular Mandap sections in BOH staging tent allows overnight turnaround under 6 hours.
direction: Approve overnight turnaround schedule and post-wedding Mandap outdoor photo reuse workflow.

options.text: Approve 6-Hour Overnight Turnaround + Mandap Post-Wedding Photo Repurposing (Recommended)
Request Extended 8-Hour Setup Window (delays morning ritual start)

title: Photography Sightlines, Drone & Cable Audit
dilemma: Ensuring zero trip hazards, drone propeller hazards, or guest head obstructions in official cinematography.
benchmark: DGCA India & Event Safety Alliance: Strictly no drone flights within enclosed marquee environments.
direction: Locked in OS: Strictly no indoor drones; 8ft clear central camera dolly corridor; heavy-duty rubber cable ramps taped down.

options.text: Outdoor-Only Drone Invariant + 8ft Clear Camera Dolly Track + Rubber Cable Ramps (Certified)

title: Commercial BOQ & 4-Tier Budget Settlement
dilemma: Negotiating fair vendor pricing across permanent base shell, transformations, and variable items.
benchmark: Commercial Procurement Standard: 3-tier cost breakdown (Base Shell, Transformations, Variables) locks vendor accountability.
direction: Locked in OS: Tier A (₹6.5L), Tier B (₹4.8L), Tier C (₹3.2L). Settlement target: ₹11.5L–₹12.5L.

options.text: 4-Tier Commercial Negotiation Framework (20% Advance, 50% Handover, 30% Retention) (Certified)

title: Technical, Structural & Fire Safety Certification
dilemma: Eliminating fire and wind collapse risks on open ground with 500+ guests.
benchmark: National Building Code of India (NBC Part 4): All temporary tensile fabrics must carry DIN 4102 B1 flame-retardant certification.
direction: Decorator must deliver signed flame-retardant certificates, 100 km/h wind rating, and extinguisher placement plan.
vendorDeliverable: Flame-Retardant Fabric Certificate + Fire Extinguisher Layout (Due T-14 Days)

title: Physical Mock-up & Material Sample Gate
dilemma: Color calibration errors and texture disappointments when relying solely on WhatsApp photos.
benchmark: High-End Event Protocol: Physical mock-up table presented at T-14 days with actual linen, gold metal, chair cushion, and florals.
direction: Mandatory T-14 physical sample inspection table before final 50% setup release. Strictly no WhatsApp-only approvals.
vendorDeliverable: 1:1 Physical Sample Mock-up Table (Due T-14 Days at Venue)
